On the morning of September 4, the day Reuters published its story, at 8:52 a.m. European time, the Austrian administrator posted a notice on the DseWiki homepage: "Over the past few months, DseWiki has been the target of intense AI agent activity. From now on, editing requires password-protected permissions."

A wiki where "anyone could modify any page" had been open for 25 years. On September 4, 2026, it locked its doors for good.
